name: panel-brief
title: Panel composition working paper

sections.title: Mandate
sections.sql: select code,name,purpose,owner,starts_on,ends_on from panels where id=$1

sections.title: Appointments
sections.sql: select code,expert,position,starts_on,ends_on,status,blockers from v_term_readiness where panel_id=$1 order by position,expert

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where panel_id=$1 order by created_at
